hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; if [ "${f##*/}" = "html_report.py" ]; then printf '%s' '{"systemMessage":"Visual QA: html_report.py changed, screenshot before committing.","hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"UI source changed. Run uv run python -m bench.screenshot, Read the PNGs in results/shots/ at BOTH widths (NN-*.png desktop and m-NN-*.png phone), and iterate until the design is right before committing."}}'; fi; }
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */results/shots/*.png) printf '%s %s\n' "$(date +%s)" "${f##*/}" >> results/shots/.viewed;; esac; }

IN=$(cat); CMD=$(printf '%s' "$IN" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); case "$CMD" in *"git commit"*) :;; *) exit 0;; esac; STAGED=$(git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null); printf '%s\n' "$STAGED" | grep -qE '^(bench/html_report\.py|results/report\.html)$' || exit 0; M=results/shots/.fresh; if [ ! -e "$M" ] || [ bench/html_report.py -nt "$M" ] || [ results/report.html -nt "$M" ]; then echo 'Visual QA stale: UI files staged but screenshots predate them. Run: uv run python -m bench.screenshot' >&2; exit 2; fi; V=results/shots/.viewed; T=$(stat -c %Y "$M" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); D=0; P=0; if [ -e "$V" ]; then while read -r ts name; do [ "${ts:-0}" -ge "$T" ] 2>/dev/null || continue; case "$name" in m-*) P=1;; *) D=1;; esac; done < "$V"; fi; if [ "$D" = 0 ] || [ "$P" = 0 ]; then MISS=''; [ "$D" = 0 ] && MISS='desktop (NN-*.png)'; [ "$P" = 0 ] && MISS="$MISS${MISS:+ and }phone (m-NN-*.png)"; echo "Visual QA unseen: screenshots are fresh but you have not opened any $MISS shot since they were taken. Read the PNGs for the sections you changed at both widths, then commit. (A fresh screenshot showed the broken mobile scorecards on 2026-08-04 and shipped anyway, because nobody looked at that file.)" >&2; exit 2; fi
